name: Ways to work together | Wild Lake Studio
description: Sovereign A&R, talent architecture, stewardship subscriptions, project commissions, and advisory engagements at Wild Lake Studio.

hasPart.name: Areas of practice.
hasPart.text: The studio & venture Areas of practice. The core offering is undivided attention. Close study of the artist, the work, and the conditions shaping both. We observe, listen, and stay with the material long enough to offer a precise response. We scout talent and work with artists directly, or partner with record labels, galleries, and booking agencies. In either case, the artist enters the engagement willingly, on their own initiative or through a representative. Every engagement begins with an agreed scope and an upfront monthly Stewardship subscription or fixed project fee. 01.0 // Sovereign A&R Multidisciplinary Artist & Repertoire: scouting artists and developing complete bodies of work across music, visual art, literature, and film through critique, direction, and critical framing. The artist retains 100% ownership and creative control. Wild-Lake takes 0% IP ownership and 0% revenue share.

hasPart.name: Retainer terms.
hasPart.text: Our commitment Retainer terms. Focused intervention. Space to execute. The monthly Stewardship subscription keeps studio capacity available between interventions. We come close to observe and edit, then step away while the artist executes on their own timeline. Wild-Lake takes no percentage of artist earnings or ownership of their intellectual property. Scope & deliverables Every retained engagement begins with a fixed-scope architectural proposal. Depending on the artist's stage, deliverables include a written practice audit, a complete repertoire and catalog map, a six-month working rhythm and boundary protocol, or a bare-metal digital platform build. You never buy vague stewardship. You buy concrete structural outputs with set review milestones. 01 Ownership The client retains ownership of their work. The Studio retains its proprietary frameworks and licenses delivered framework materials for the client’s practice. Public-facing writing transfers to the client upon final settlement. 02 Availability & interventions The client triggers an intervention when it is needed. We agree response times, reserved capacity, and the scope of each intervention in advance. Periods of absence are part of the engagement, giving the artist room to work independently. Their consent and creative control remain explicit throughout. 03 Fees The subscription is paid monthly in advance for reserved availability across the agreed cadence. Project commissions carry a fixed fee. We agree additional scope before work begins. Read the full Terms of practice © 2026 Wild Lake Studio LLC. All rights reserved.
